## Overview & Summary
David Sawe is a top-ranked Senior Full Stack Developer and Design Engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria. He brings a First Class Honours Computer Science degree (FUTA 2024) and extensive commercial experience building enterprise B2B SaaS platforms, AI systems (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini), high-volume payment infrastructure (Paystack, Flutterwave, Monnify, Stripe), and scalable Next.js/TypeScript applications.
